rules.title: Visa not required for Indians
rules.detail: Carry passport (preferred), Voter ID, or PAN/Aadhaar. Aadhaar alone is weak — pair with Voter ID.

rules.title: Bhansar (Customs) permit
rules.detail: Daily fee at border. Pay 2–3 buffer days beyond planned exit.

rules.title: Yatayat (Transport) permit
rules.detail: Separate from Bhansar. Same buffer logic.

rules.title: 30-day cumulative cap (2026)
rules.detail: Indian vehicles capped at 30 cumulative days/year. Overstay = vehicle impoundment.

rules.title: Firm-registered SUV authorization
rules.detail: Authorization letter on firm letterhead stating personal-travel use is critical to avoid commercial slabs.

rules.title: Used personal electronics
rules.detail: Laptops/phones/cameras with prior-purchase invoices = exempt. Carry both MacBook invoices.

rules.title: New unboxed goods (NPR 100 rule)
rules.detail: New retail items may be assessed. Avoid carrying unopened electronics.

rules.title: Left-hand drive, lights ON in mountains
rules.detail: Speed: 40 town / 60–80 highway / 30 switchbacks. Zero-tolerance on alcohol.

rules.title: Mustang fuel scarcity
rules.detail: Beni and Jomsom are the only reliable pumps en route to Muktinath. Top up at both.

rules.title: INR notes
rules.detail: INR 100/200/500 widely accepted; INR 2000 notes NOT accepted.

rules.title: NTC vs Ncell
rules.detail: NTC = better Mustang coverage. Ncell = faster Pokhara speeds.

rules.title: Indian policy doesn't cover Nepal
rules.detail: Buy Nepal-only third-party at the border, OR confirm rider with insurer.

rules.title: ACAP for Mustang region
rules.detail: SAARC NPR 1,000/person. Issued at Pokhara NTB. Required beyond Beni.

rules.title: Lower Mustang vs Upper
rules.detail: Jomsom/Kagbeni/Muktinath = Lower (open zone, ACAP only). Upper (Lo Manthang) = restricted USD 500/10d.

rules.title: Muktinath at 3,800 m
rules.detail: Acclimatise at Jomsom overnight. Diamox prophylaxis. Watch for ataxia/breathlessness — descend immediately if seen.

rules.title: Drones and sat phones
rules.detail: Drones rarely permitted. Sat phones banned without prior permit. Leave at home.

emergencies.label: CIWEC Hospital, Kathmandu
emergencies.note: Travel medicine specialist; Pokhara branch too.
